name: grok-subagent
description: Unofficial ChatGPT plugin bridge to local Grok Build via private Secure MCP Tunnel and native ACP, with Codex support.

interface.shortDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your local Grok Build.
interface.longDescription: Unofficial, experimental ChatGPT plugin bridge to local Grok Build. Connect through a private OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel to start, inspect, continue, interrupt and close Grok ACP sessions. Separate account configuration is required; cloud ChatGPT end-to-end connectivity is not yet verified. Also supports local Codex MCP. Not an OS sandbox or a multi-user remote execution service.
defaultPrompt: Use Grok to investigate an authorized task.
Check the progress of my Grok jobs.
Interrupt my Grok task and send a correction.
